sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但查明她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本期节目最初发布在“档案档案”的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium订阅源上，作为给我们付费订阅者的早期福利。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些节目的设计略短一些，使我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件范围。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 要提前且无广告地收听这些节目，您可以在您喜爱的平台上支持“档案档案”。

sentences.en: In late July 2015, 28-year-old civil engineer Mark Van Dongen was using an online dating site when he met a woman named Violet.
sentences.zh: 2015年7月下旬，28岁的土木工程师马克·范·东根在使用一个在线交友网站时，遇到了一位名叫维奥莱特的女性。

sentences.en: Like Mark, Violet lived in the English city of Bristol.
sentences.zh: 和马克一样，维奥莱特住在英国的布里斯托尔市。

sentences.en: The two chatted online for a week before deciding to meet up for a coffee.
sentences.zh: 两人在网上聊了一个星期，然后决定见面喝杯咖啡。

sentences.en: The first date went so well that they arranged to go to the cinema together a few days later.
sentences.zh: 第一次约会非常顺利，于是他们安排几天后一起去电影院。

sentences.en: Affection quickly blossomed, and by mid-August, the pair were contemplating a serious relationship.
sentences.zh: 爱意迅速滋生，到了8月中旬，两人已经开始考虑建立认真的恋爱关系了。

sentences.en: There was just one problem.
sentences.zh: 只有一个问题。

sentences.en: Mark already had a girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 马克已经有了一个女朋友。

sentences.en: Five years earlier, he'd met a 40-year-old South African woman named Berlina Wallace through an online dating site.
sentences.zh: 五年前，他通过一个在线交友网站认识了一位40岁的南非女性，名叫贝尔琳娜·华莱士。

sentences.en: Despite the 18-year age gap between the two and the fact they lived in different countries, they hit it off.
sentences.zh: 尽管两人有18岁的年龄差距，而且生活在不同的国家，但他们一拍即合。

sentences.en: Mark had been living in his home country of the Netherlands at the time, while Berlina was living in the United Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 马克当时住在他的祖国荷兰，而贝尔琳娜住在英国。

sentences.en: Mark flew to the UK to take Berlina on a date, and the two became intimate.
sentences.zh: 马克飞往英国邀请贝尔琳娜约会，两人有了亲密关系。

sentences.en: Mark returned to the Netherlands shortly after, but a few weeks later, Berlina contacted him with some news.
sentences.zh: 马克不久后返回荷兰，但几周后，贝尔琳娜联系了他，并带给他一些消息。

sentences.en: She told him she was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他她怀孕了。

sentences.en: Mark wanted to do the decent thing, so he relocated to the UK.
sentences.zh: 马克想做一个正派的人，于是他搬到了英国。

sentences.en: He moved in with Berlina in Bristol, enrolled in university, and found work as an engineer on a large construction project.
sentences.zh: 他搬去和布里斯托尔的贝尔琳娜同居，注册上了大学，并在一个大型建筑项目找到了一份工程师的工作。

sentences.en: But, after a few months, Berlina told Mark she'd miscarried the baby.
sentences.zh: 但是，几个月后，贝尔琳娜告诉马克她流产了。

sentences.en: Mark stayed in the relationship regardless, having developed strong feelings for Berlina.
sentences.zh: 马克不管怎样还是留在这段关系中，因为他对贝尔琳娜产生了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: The majority of his income was used to support Berlina, as well as her family back in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 他大部分的收入都用来支持贝尔琳娜以及她在南非的家人。

sentences.en: Over the years, the relationship struggled, and by the time Mark met Violet, he'd been planning to leave Berlina for a while.
sentences.zh: 多年来，这段感情维系得很艰难，到马克遇到维奥莱特时，他已经打算离开贝尔琳娜一段时间了。

sentences.en: He admitted the truth about his relationship status to Violet, and she wasn't exactly pleased by the news.
sentences.zh: 他对维奥莱特坦白了自己的感情状况，而这个消息并没有让她感到高兴。

sentences.en: The two decided to stop seeing each other until Mark sorted himself out.
sentences.zh: 两人决定停止交往，直到马克把自己的事情处理好。

sentences.en: A few days later, Mark contacted Violet to say he'd ended things with Berlina and was moving into a hotel.
sentences.zh: 几天后，马克联系维奥莱特，说他已经和贝尔琳娜分手了，正在搬进一家酒店。

sentences.en: Mark and Violet agreed to rekindle their romance.
sentences.zh: 马克和维奥莱特同意重燃爱火。

sentences.en: However, Mark urged Violet not to send any more emails to his current address.
sentences.zh: 然而，马克敦促维奥莱特不要再往他当前的地址发任何电子邮件。

sentences.en: His ex-girlfriend, Berlina Wallace, had hacked his account.
sentences.zh: 他的前女友贝尔琳娜·华莱士黑了他的账户。

sentences.en: At the end of August, Mark checked out of his hotel room and moved in with Violet.
sentences.zh: 八月底，马克退了酒店房间，搬去和维奥莱特同居。

sentences.en: On the day he arrived, Violet was shocked by what she saw.
sentences.zh: 在他到达的那天，维奥莱特被眼前的景象惊呆了。

sentences.en: Mark had a fingernail gouge mark around his neck and nearly a dozen 4-inch gouges on his back and cheSt.
sentences.zh: 马克的脖子周围有一道指甲抓痕，背部和胸前有将近十几道4英寸长的抓痕。

sentences.en: When Violet asked what happened, Mark said Berlina had attacked him.
sentences.zh: 当维奥莱特问发生了什么事时，马克说贝尔琳娜袭击了他。

sentences.en: Later that day, Violet began receiving anonymous phone calls.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，维奥莱特开始接到匿名电话。

sentences.en: When she picked up, the caller on the other line remained silent.
sentences.zh: 当她接听时，电话那头的人保持沉默。

sentences.en: Over the next 72 hours, she received 13 more of these calls.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的72小时里，她又接到了13个这样的电话。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Mark's mobile phone was ringing around the clock.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，马克的手机日夜响个不停。

sentences.en: It was Berlina Wallace and she was not happy.
sentences.zh: 那是贝尔琳娜·华莱士，她很不高兴。

sentences.en: Berlina switched between screaming at Mark to crying and hyperventilating.
sentences.zh: 贝尔琳娜情绪大起大落，一会儿对马克尖叫，一会儿又哭泣和过度换气。

sentences.en: On September 2, Berlina made a call that finally pushed Mark over the edge.
sentences.zh: 9月2日，贝尔琳娜打了一个电话，终于把马克逼到了崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: He contacted the police, telling the operator,
sentences.zh: 他联系了警方，告诉接线员：

sentences.en: Mark Van Dongen told the emergency operator that when he ended things with Berlina Wallace two weeks earlier, she'd threatened to stab herself.
sentences.zh: 马克·范·东根告诉紧急接线员，两周前他和贝尔琳娜·华莱士分手时，她曾威胁要自残。

sentences.en: She didn't go through with this threat, but instead grabbed a handful of pills and swallowed them in front of Mark.
sentences.zh: 她没有付诸行动，而是抓了一把药丸，在马克面前吞了下去。

sentences.en: He phoned for an ambulance and Berlina was taken to hospital.
sentences.zh: 他叫了救护车，贝尔琳娜被送往医院。

sentences.en: After Mark moved out, she harassed him with phone calls and text messages.
sentences.zh: 马克搬走后，她用电话和短信骚扰他。

sentences.en: Finally, he received an email from Berlina claiming that a close friend of hers had suffered a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 最后，他收到了一封贝尔琳娜发来的电子邮件，声称她的一位密友心脏病发作。

sentences.en: She accused Mark of abandoning her in her time of need and demanded that he call her immediately.
sentences.zh: 她指责马克在她需要的时候抛弃了她，并要求他立刻给她打电话。

sentences.en: Mark reluctantly made the call.
sentences.zh: 马克很不情愿地打了电话。

sentences.en: Berlina was sobbing, saying she wouldn't stop crying until Mark came to see her in person.
sentences.zh: 贝尔琳娜泣不成声，说只要马克不亲自来看她，她就不会停止哭泣。

sentences.en: Mark refused, asking Berlina to just leave him and his new girlfriend alone.
sentences.zh: 马克拒绝了，要求贝尔琳娜放过他和他的新女友。

sentences.en: He hung up, but Berlina kept trying to call him back.
sentences.zh: 他挂断了电话，但贝尔琳娜一直在试图回拨。

sentences.en: Mark eventually picked up.
sentences.zh: 马克最终接了电话。

sentences.en: Berlina screamed that if he didn't do what she wanted, she'd call the police and tell them Mark had been downloading child abuse images.
sentences.zh: 贝尔琳娜尖叫着说，如果他不按她说的做，她就会报警，告诉警方马克下载了虐童图片。

sentences.en: Exasperated, Mark called the police emergency line, telling the operator, something needs to be done about it.
sentences.zh: 忍无可忍的马克拨打了警方报警电话，告诉接线员，必须对此采取一些措施。

sentences.en: The next day, Mark went to the local police station and showed an officer the dozens of text messages and emails Berlina Wallace had sent him.
sentences.zh: 第二天，马克去了当地的警察局，向一名警官展示了贝尔琳娜·华莱士发给他的几十条短信和电子邮件。

sentences.en: The officer believed the messages were pleading in nature rather than harassing, but she agreed to speak with Berlina regardless.
sentences.zh: 这名警官认为这些信息带有恳求性质，而不是骚扰，但她还是同意与贝尔琳娜谈谈。

sentences.en: Later that day, the officer visited Berlina at her flat and explained that Mark Van Dongen had lodged a complaint against her.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，警官拜访了贝尔琳娜的公寓，并解释说马克·范·东根对她提出了投诉。

sentences.en: She urged Berlina to seek help from her GP if she was struggling with the breakup.
sentences.zh: 她敦促贝尔琳娜如果难以走出分手阴影，可以向全科医生寻求帮助。

sentences.en: The officer was also aware that Mark had agreed to continue paying Berlina's bills and the university tuition for her fashion degree.
sentences.zh: 这名警官还知道，马克同意继续支付贝尔琳娜的账单以及她时装学位课程的学费。

sentences.en: She recommended that Berlina contact an advice line if she was struggling financially.
sentences.zh: 她建议贝尔琳娜如果经济困难，可以拨打咨询热线。

sentences.en: The officer explained that the silent phone calls to Violet's flat could be easily traced if necessary and instructed Berlina to cease all contact with Mark and his new girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 警官解释说，如果有必要，拨往维奥莱特公寓的无声电话可以轻易被追查到，并指示贝尔琳娜停止与马克及其新女友的一切联系。

sentences.en: Less than three weeks later, on September 21, Mark received another message from Berlina.
sentences.zh: 不到三周后，即9月21日，马克收到了贝尔琳娜的又一条消息。

sentences.en: She said she was so devastated by their breakup that she planned to quit her university course and return to South Africa.
sentences.zh: 她说她对两人的分手感到无比痛心，以至于她打算退学并返回南非。

sentences.en: She wanted Mark to give her money to pay for the plane ticket.
sentences.zh: 她希望马克给她钱支付机票费用。

sentences.en: Mark refused.
sentences.zh: 马克拒绝了。

sentences.en: The next day, Berlina called Mark, begging him to come see her.
sentences.zh: 第二天，贝尔琳娜打电话给马克，恳求他来看看她。

sentences.en: Given Berlina's history of self-harm, Mark worried about what she might do to herself.
sentences.zh: 鉴于贝尔琳娜有自残史，马克很担心她会对做出什么出格的事。

sentences.en: He told Berlina he would go to her flat that evening.
sentences.zh: 他告诉贝尔琳娜他今晚会去她的公寓。

sentences.en: But first, Mark went home to Violet.
sentences.zh: 但在此之前，马克先回了维奥莱特家。

sentences.en: He reassured her that he was committed to their relationship, but felt that he needed to do this.
sentences.zh: 他向她保证自己对这段感情是忠诚的，但觉得他必须去处理这件事。

sentences.en: Mark arrived at Berlina's flat on Ladysmith Road at about 6pm.
sentences.zh: 马克于傍晚6点左右到达了位于拉迪斯史密斯路的贝尔琳娜的公寓。

sentences.en: As they prepared dinner, they chatted about their relationship.
sentences.zh: 在准备晚餐时，他们聊起了两人的关系。

sentences.en: Mark reiterated that he had no intention of getting back together.
sentences.zh: 马克重申他绝没有复合的打算。

sentences.en: An argument broke out, and at around 10pm, Berlina packed a few belongings and left the flat, saying she was going to check into a hotel.
sentences.zh: 争吵爆发了，晚上10点左右，贝尔琳娜收拾了一些随身物品离开公寓，说她要去登记入住一家酒店。

sentences.en: Given the late hour, Mark decided to stay in the flat overnight.
sentences.zh: 鉴于时间已晚，马克决定留在公寓过夜。

sentences.en: He undressed down to his boxer shorts and slipped into bed.
sentences.zh: 他脱得只剩一条平角短裤，钻进被窝。

sentences.en: Soon, he was sound asleep.
sentences.zh: 不久，他就进入了熟睡状态。

sentences.en: At 3am, Berlina's neighbour, Thomas, awoke to a screeching sound that he thought was foxes fighting.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点，贝尔琳娜的邻居托马斯被一阵刺耳的尖叫声惊醒，他以为是狐狸在打架。

sentences.en: He grabbed a club from his golf bag, intending to break up the scuffle.
sentences.zh: 他从高尔夫球包里拿出一根球杆，打算去把打架的动物驱散。

sentences.en: But when he stepped outside, he realised it wasn't foxes.
sentences.zh: 但当他走到外面时，他意识到那不是狐狸。

sentences.en: Someone was screaming the words, help me.
sentences.zh: 有人在惨叫着“救救我”。

sentences.en: Thomas ran to the end of Ladysmith Road and found Mark Van Dongen wearing nothing but boxer shorts.
sentences.zh: 托马斯跑到拉迪斯史密斯路的尽头，发现马克·范·东根身上只穿着一条平角短裤。

sentences.en: He was clearly in distress, but Thomas didn't understand what was happening.
sentences.zh: 他显然痛苦不堪，但托马斯不明白发生了什么。

sentences.en: He thought perhaps Mark had taken LSD and was having a bad trip.
sentences.zh: 他以为马克可能是磕了LSD（麦角酸二乙酰胺），正在经历糟糕的幻觉之旅。

sentences.en: It looked like he'd been to a rave.
sentences.zh: 看起来他像是刚去过锐舞派对一样。

sentences.en: His face and upper body were covered in dark grey paint.
sentences.zh: 他的脸和上半身都覆盖着深灰色的颜料。

sentences.en: A split second later, Thomas realised his mistake.
sentences.zh: 转瞬之间，托马斯意识到自己想错了。

sentences.en: He asked Mark what had happened.
sentences.zh: 他问马克发生了什么事。

sentences.en: In a high-pitched distress, Mark cried out.
sentences.zh: 带着痛苦的高音，马克大声哭喊。

sentences.en: Someone threw acid or something over me.
sentences.zh: 有人把酸液之类的东西泼在我身上。

sentences.en: Can't you see?
sentences.zh: 难道你看不见吗？

sentences.en: Thomas immediately called emergency services.
sentences.zh: 托马斯立即拨打了紧急救援服务电话。

sentences.en: When the operator instructed Thomas to ask Mark who did this to him, Mark responded.
sentences.zh: 当接线员指示托马斯问马克是谁对他的时，马克回答了。

sentences.en: My ex.
sentences.zh: 我的前女友。

sentences.en: The operator told Thomas to take Mark to a shower and have him thoroughly wash his entire body.
sentences.zh: 接线员告诉托马斯带马克去冲淋房，让他彻底清洗全身。

sentences.en: Other neighbours had emerged from their houses and one offered the use of his bathroom.
sentences.zh: 其他邻居也从屋里出来了，其中一人主动提出借用自家的浴室。

sentences.en: As the group ushered the still screaming Mark back down Ladysmith Road, his distress increased.
sentences.zh: 当大家护送依然在尖叫的马克沿着拉迪斯史密斯路往回走时，他的痛苦加剧了。

sentences.en: He fearfully pointed at a flat and said, She lives there.
sentences.zh: 他惊恐地指着一间公寓说：“她住在那里。”

sentences.en: She lives there.
sentences.zh: 她住在那里。

sentences.en: The group assured him he was being taken to a different flat.
sentences.zh: 众人向他保证，正带他去另一间公寓。

sentences.en: When Mark stepped into the harsh lighting of the bathroom, Thomas was shocked by what he saw.
sentences.zh: 当马克走进浴室刺眼的灯光下时，托马斯被眼前的景象惊呆了。

sentences.en: He reassured Mark that an ambulance and police were on the way.
sentences.zh: 他安慰马克说救护车和警察正在路上。

sentences.en: Mark replied,
sentences.zh: 马克回答说：

sentences.en: Paramedics quickly arrived to rush Mark to hospital, but all they could do was feed him a constant supply of pain-relieving gas along the way.
sentences.zh: 急救人员迅速赶到，将马克紧急送往医院，但一路上他们能做的只有不断给他输入镇痛气体。

sentences.en: Even so, Mark continued to scream in agony.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，马克依然痛苦得放声尖叫。

sentences.en: He implored a police officer who was riding with them to check if his girlfriend Violet was okay.
sentences.zh: 他恳求随车的警官去看看他的女友维奥莱特是否安好。

sentences.en: He then pointed to a tattoo on his lower stomach.
sentences.zh: 接着他指了指小腹上的一个纹身。

sentences.en: It was the name Berlina.
sentences.zh: 那是贝尔琳娜的名字。

sentences.en: Mark told the officer,
sentences.zh: 马克对警官说：

sentences.en: She needs to go to prison for this.
sentences.zh: 她必须为这事入狱。

sentences.en: Throughout the two-mile journey, Mark's distress escalated.
sentences.zh: 在两英里的车程中，马克的痛苦不断升级。

sentences.en: He kept shouting about his eyes, saying that he could hardly see.
sentences.zh: 他不停地大喊自己的眼睛，说自己几乎什么也看不见了。

sentences.en: He begged those in the ambulance to tell him if he still had eyelids.
sentences.zh: 他哀求救护车上的人告诉他，他是否还有眼皮。

sentences.en: On arrival, he was taken to the hospital's decontamination unit.
sentences.zh: 到达医院后，他被送进了医院的洗消区。

sentences.en: Through the haze of his failing eyesight, Mark caught a brief glimpse of his own reflection.
sentences.zh: 透过视力衰退带来的模糊视线，马克短暂地瞥见了自己倒影。

sentences.en: He screamed,
sentences.zh: 他尖叫道：

sentences.en: Kill me now.
sentences.zh: 现在就杀了我吧。

sentences.zh: 档案档案稍后回归。

sentences.en: The hospital's emergency doctor determined that Mark Van Dongen had been doused with highly corrosive, concentrated sulfuric acid.
sentences.zh: 医院的急诊医生确定，马克·范·东根被泼了具有强腐蚀性的浓硫酸。

sentences.en: The acid had first covered Mark's entire face and then splashed down his body.
sentences.zh: 酸液首先浸透了马克的整张脸，然后溅落到他的身上。

sentences.en: Within seconds of the acid making contact, Mark's skin had been burned, turning to blackened, dead tissue.
sentences.zh: 在酸液接触身体的几秒钟内，马克的皮肤就被烧焦，变成了发黑的死组织。

sentences.en: By the time he arrived at the hospital, the skin on his face had melted away.
sentences.zh: 当他到达医院时，他脸上的皮肤已经融化了。

sentences.en: His nose had completely disintegrated and his left ear and both eyelids were gone.
sentences.zh: 他的鼻子已经完全瓦解，左耳和双眼皮都不见了。

sentences.en: His eyes had turned grey and they were dissolving.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛变成了灰色，正在溶解。

sentences.en: Mark slipped into a coma.
sentences.zh: 马克陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: Officers converged on Berlina Wallace's flat.
sentences.zh: 警察聚集到贝尔琳娜·华莱士的公寓。

sentences.en: Berlina was sitting in her living room, appearing completely calm and collected.
sentences.zh: 贝尔琳娜坐在起居室里，显得异常平静和镇定。

sentences.en: In front of her was a towel with a pair of acid wash jeans on top.
sentences.zh: 在她面前是一条毛巾，上面放着一条酸洗牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Next to the jeans was a paintbrush and a glass mug with a few drops of clear liquid inside.
sentences.zh: 牛仔裤旁边是一把画笔和一个玻璃马克杯，里面有几滴清澈的液体。

sentences.en: One of the officers asked Berlina if she knew what substance had injured Mark.
sentences.zh: 其中一名警官问贝尔琳娜是否知道是什么物质伤害了马克。

sentences.en: Berlina gestured to the items on the floor and replied,
sentences.zh: 贝尔琳娜指着地上的物品回答说：

sentences.en: The liquid in the mug had come from a white plastic bottle officers found on the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 马克杯里的液体来自警察在厨房桌子上发现的一个白色塑料瓶。

sentences.en: It had no label but contained a clear, odourless liquid that proved to be sulfuric acid.
sentences.zh: 它没有标签，但里面装着一种清澈无味的液体，经证实是硫酸。

sentences.en: Berlina claimed she'd originally bought the acid to clean out some of the flat's smelly drains.
sentences.zh: 贝尔琳娜声称她最初买硫酸是为了清理公寓里一些有异味的下水道。

sentences.en: When officers went into the bedroom, they saw what looked like a black tar splashed all over the bed.
sentences.zh: 当警官走进卧室时，他们看到床上溅满了像黑色柏油一样的东西。

sentences.en: Upon closer inspection, they realised the substance was actually the white cotton bedding melted by acid.
sentences.zh: 仔细检查后，他们发现这种物质实际上是被酸溶解的白色棉质寝具。

sentences.en: The blackened patches were concentrated on two pillows and a particular section of the duvet.
sentences.zh: 发黑的斑块集中在两个枕头和羽绒被的特定部分。

sentences.en: Berlina Wallace was arrested and taken into custody.
sentences.zh: 贝尔琳娜·华莱士被逮捕并拘留。

sentences.en: She claimed that just before 3am she and Mark had gotten into an argument.
sentences.zh: 她声称，就在凌晨3点之前，她和马克发生了一场争吵。

sentences.en: He became violent and started to pull on her underwear.
sentences.zh: 变得十分暴力并开始拉扯她的内衣。

sentences.en: To defend herself, Berlina picked up a glass from the bedside table and threw its contents on Mark.
sentences.zh: 为了自卫，贝尔琳娜拿起床头柜上的一个玻璃杯，把里面的东西泼向了马克。

sentences.en: She assumed it was filled with water, as Mark always poured her a glass before bed.
sentences.zh: 她以为里面装的是水，因为马克睡觉前总会给她倒一杯水。

sentences.en: Prior to their fight, he'd told her to use it to take her medication.
sentences.zh: 在他们争吵之前，他曾告诉她用它来送服药物。

sentences.en: But when she saw Mark's skin turn black and smoke start to rise, Berlina realised it wasn't water.
sentences.zh: 但当她看到马克的皮肤变成黑色并开始冒烟时，柏莉娜意识到那不是水。

sentences.en: Mark began screaming in pain, so Berlina rushed him into the shower before going to grab some paper towels to wipe him down.
sentences.zh: 马克痛苦得大声尖叫，于是柏莉娜急忙把他扶进淋浴间，然后去拿纸巾为他擦拭。

sentences.en: Berlina told the detectives that Mark had put the acid into the glass himself, saying,
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜对侦探们说，是马克自己把酸倒进杯子里的，她说道：

sentences.en: He wanted me to burn my insides.
sentences.zh: 他想让我体内被烧伤。

sentences.en: Can you imagine?
sentences.zh: 你能想象吗？

sentences.en: Can you imagine?
sentences.zh: 你能想象吗？

sentences.en: Mark betrayed me.
sentences.zh: 马克背叛了我。

sentences.en: Detectives asked Berlina why she didn't call for an ambulance after Mark ran out of the flat screaming in pain.
sentences.zh: 侦探们询问柏莉娜，为什么在马克痛苦尖叫着跑出公寓后，她没有叫救护车。

sentences.en: Berlina said it hadn't even crossed her mind, explaining,
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜说她根本没往那方面想，并解释道：

sentences.en: You know, I was just confused about loads of things.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我当时脑子里乱作一团。

sentences.en: I was confused.
sentences.zh: 我很混乱。

sentences.en: Detectives didn't buy Berlina Wallace's story for a second.
sentences.zh: 侦探们一点也不相信柏莉娜·华莱士的说法。

sentences.en: She said she'd purchased the acid to clean the flat's drains, but these were tested and it was clear they hadn't been cleaned in quite some time.
sentences.zh: 她说她买酸是为了清理公寓的下水道，但经过检测，很明显这些下水道已经很久没有清理过了。

sentences.en: Berlina was charged with the offence of throwing a corrosive substance with the intent to burn, maim, disfigure or disable Mark Van Dongen.
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜被指控犯有投掷腐蚀性物质罪，意图灼伤、致残、毁容或伤害马克·范·东根。

sentences.en: With Mark in a coma and unable to assist the investigation, police turned to his family and friends to help.
sentences.zh: 由于马克陷入昏迷，无法协助调查，警方只得向他的家人和朋友寻求帮助。

sentences.en: According to Mark's father, Case, his son had sought medical care four years earlier for burns to his arm.
sentences.zh: 据马克的父亲凯斯透露，四年前他的儿子曾因手臂烧伤寻求过医疗救助。

sentences.en: Mark had told the doctor he'd dropped a hot cup of tea over himself, but that was a lie.
sentences.zh: 马克曾告诉医生，他不小心把一杯热茶洒在了自己身上，但那是谎言。

sentences.en: After arguing about something insignificant, Berlina crept up behind him while he was sitting on the sofa and threw boiling water over his arm.
sentences.zh: 在为一些琐事争吵后，趁马克坐在沙发上时，柏莉娜悄悄走到他身后，将开水泼在了他的手臂上。

sentences.en: Case explained that Mark had always been more in love with Berlina than she was with him, but Berlina was jealous by nature.
sentences.zh: 凯斯解释说，马克对柏莉娜的爱一直胜过柏莉娜对他的爱，但柏莉娜天生嫉妒心强。

sentences.en: Mark had confided in his dad that Berlina sometimes hit herself in the face, so she looked bruised and beaten.
sentences.zh: 马克曾向父亲吐露，柏莉娜有时会自己打自己的脸，好让脸上看起来青一块紫一块、伤痕累累。

sentences.en: She'd then threatened to report Mark for domestic violence if he ever left her.
sentences.zh: 如果马克以后离开她，她就会威胁要以家庭暴力罪举报他。

sentences.en: To prevent him from returning to the Netherlands or checking into a hotel, she sometimes stole his passport and hid it.
sentences.zh: 为了阻止他返回荷兰或入住酒店，她有时会偷走并藏起他的护照。

sentences.en: A colleague of Mark's recalled that Mark had once lifted his shirt to reveal fingernail gouge marks across his back and cheSt.
sentences.zh: 马克的一位同事回忆说，马克曾掀起衬衫，露出背部和胸前被指甲抓伤的痕迹。

sentences.en: Some were fresh, while others had already begun to heal and scar.
sentences.zh: 有些伤口还很新，而另一些已经开始愈合并留下了疤痕。

sentences.en: Mark was a tall, strong man, often referred to as a gentle giant.
sentences.zh: 马克身材高大强壮，人们常说他是温和的巨人。

sentences.en: When he stood next to Berlina, he towered over her petite frame.
sentences.zh: 当他站在柏莉娜旁边时，他那娇小的身躯相形见绌。

sentences.en: Yet, in the months leading up to the attack, Mark had confided in his father and friends that he was becoming more and more afraid of Berlina and what she might be capable of.
sentences.zh: 然而，在袭击发生前的几个月里，马克曾向父亲和朋友吐露，他越来越害怕柏莉娜，也害怕她会做出什么事来。

sentences.en: Detectives obtained a warrant to access Berlina's psychological history.
sentences.zh: 侦探们获得了查阅柏莉娜心理病史的搜查令。

sentences.en: They discovered that in December 2013, she'd spoken with a university counsellor about her anger issues.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，在2013年12月，她曾就自己的愤怒情绪问题咨询过大学辅导员。

sentences.en: She had admitted to being physically violent with people and to using threatening and intimidating behaviour, especially towards Mark.
sentences.zh: 她承认自己对他人实施过身体暴力，并有过威胁和恐吓行为，尤其是针对马克。

sentences.en: In a session with the university's psychiatric nurse the following year, Berlina had described feeling an adrenaline rush whenever she felt wronged by someone.
sentences.zh: 第二年，在与大学精神科护士的一次会面中，柏莉娜曾描述说，每当她觉得自己被别人冤枉时，就会产生一种肾上腺素飙升的感觉。

sentences.en: She said it made her want to destroy everything around her.
sentences.zh: 她说这让她想摧毁周围的一切。

sentences.en: After Mark ended their relationship, Berlina told this same nurse that she wasn't coping.
sentences.zh: 在马克结束了他们的恋爱关系后，柏莉娜对同一位护士说她快撑不下去了。

sentences.en: She felt depressed, anxious, betrayed and angry.
sentences.zh: 她感到沮丧、焦虑、被背叛和愤怒。

sentences.en: Berlina had deleted her internet search history, but police were able to recover it.
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜删除了她的网页浏览记录，但警方成功将其恢复。

sentences.en: A forensic search of her phone and computer revealed that in the days leading up to the attack,
sentences.zh: 对她手机和电脑的法证搜查显示，在袭击发生前的几天里，

sentences.en: Berlina had access to 82 sites that showed the damage sulfuric acid burns could do to a human being.
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜浏览过82个展示硫酸烧伤会对人体造成何种损害的网站。

sentences.en: She viewed dozens of articles about victims who'd been horribly disfigured after having sulfuric acid thrown in their faces, most of which were accompanied by graphic photographs.
sentences.zh: 她浏览了数十篇关于受害者被泼硫酸后面部严重毁容的文章，其中大部分都配有触目惊心的照片。

sentences.en: Berlina also googled phrases such as, what happens when you swallow sulfuric acid, and can I die from drinking sulfuric acid.
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜还谷歌搜索了诸如“吞食硫酸会发生什么”以及“喝硫酸会死吗”之类的短语。

sentences.en: On the same day that Mark Van Dongen contacted police asking that something be done about Berlina's blackmail threat, she visited the online store Amazon.
sentences.zh: 就在马克·范·东根联系警方要求处理柏莉娜的勒索威胁的同一天，她访问了在线商店亚马逊。

sentences.en: For just over £17, Berlina bought a one-litre bottle of 98% concentration sulfuric acid.
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜花了略多于17英镑，买了一瓶一升装浓度为98%的硫酸。

sentences.en: The following day, an officer visited her to request that she stop contacting Mark.
sentences.zh: 第二天，一名警官拜访了她，要求她停止联系马克。

sentences.en: After the officer left, Berlina phoned a mental health crisis hotline and told the operator she'd swallowed a handful of pills.
sentences.zh: 警官离开后，柏莉娜拨打了心理健康危机热线，告诉接线员她吞了一把药片。

sentences.en: An ambulance was dispatched and Berlina was taken to hospital, but discharged the following day.
sentences.zh: 救护车被派往现场，柏莉娜被送往医院，但在第二天出院。

sentences.en: A few days later, the bottle of sulfuric acid arrived.
sentences.zh: 几天后，那瓶硫酸送到了。

sentences.en: At some point, Berlina removed the bottle's label which featured a very clear warning that the contents caused severe burns and dye damage.
sentences.zh: 不知在哪个环节，柏莉娜撕掉了瓶子上的标签，上面原本有非常明显的警告，说明内容物会导致严重烧伤和染料损伤。

sentences.en: One of Berlina's online searches had led her to a case from 15 years prior,
sentences.zh: 柏莉娜的一次网络搜索让她了解到15年前的一起案件，

sentences.en: in which Birmingham man Andrew Gardner had allegedly tricked his former girlfriend into drinking sulfuric acid as a last toast, to mark the end of their relationship.
sentences.zh: 案中伯明翰男子安德鲁·加德纳涉嫌诱骗前女友喝下硫酸，作为结束恋人关系的最后干杯。

sentences.en: The victim, 27-year-old Dr Karenina Longe, cried in agony for 23 minutes before Gardner called for an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 受害者、27岁的卡雷尼娜·隆吉博士痛苦地哭喊了23分钟，加德纳才叫了救护车。

sentences.en: By that time, the acid had destroyed Karenina's mouth, throat and internal organs.
sentences.zh: 那时，硫酸已经毁掉了卡雷尼娜的嘴、喉咙和内脏器官。

sentences.en: She died in hospital hours later, while Gardner drank beer at a local pub.
sentences.zh: 几小时后她在医院死亡，而加德纳则在当地一家酒吧里喝着啤酒。

sentences.en: He claimed that Karenina had drunk the acid herself, either mistaking it for a glass of water or intentionally to take her own life.
sentences.zh: 他声称卡雷尼娜是自己喝下硫酸的，要么是误把它当成了水，要么是故意自杀。

sentences.en: At Gardner's murder trial, the jury wasn't convinced by the prosecution's evidence and the accused walked free.
sentences.zh: 在加德纳的谋杀案审判中，陪审团对检方的证据并不信服，被告最终无罪释放。

sentences.en: Detectives couldn't help but note the similarities between this case and Berlina's claim that Mark had tried to trick her into drinking acid.
sentences.zh: 侦探们不禁注意到这起案件与柏莉娜声称马克试图诱骗她喝酸的说法有诸多相似之处。

sentences.en: It was possible that she'd been inspired by Andrew Gardner's defence as a means to get away with her own crime.
sentences.zh: 她很有可能是受了安德鲁·加德纳辩护词的启发，以此来为自己的罪行开脱。

sentences.en: Mark's injuries were the most extensive and extreme that surgeons had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 马克的伤势是外科医生们见过最广泛、最极端的。

sentences.en: So much so, that photos of his injuries were withheld from the investigative team on account of being too disturbing.
sentences.zh: 甚至因为伤势照片过于惨不忍睹，而没有向调查组公开。

sentences.en: Not long after Mark lost consciousness, he'd been taken into surgery so that all of the dead tissue on his face and body could be cut away.
sentences.zh: 马克失去知觉后不久，就被推进了手术室，以便切除他脸上和身体上的所有坏死组织。

sentences.en: Healthy sections of his skin from other parts of his body were removed and grafted over the exposed areas.
sentences.zh: 医生取下他身体其他部位健康的皮肤，移植到暴露的区域。

sentences.en: By the time surgeons had completed the multiple procedures, nearly half of Mark's entire body surface had been impacted.
sentences.zh: 当外科医生完成这多项手术时，马克近一半的体表面积都受到了影响。

sentences.en: His face was disfigured and he was blind in one eye, while doctors were only just able to save a tiny fraction of sight in the other.
sentences.zh: 他的面部严重毁容，一只眼睛失明，医生仅勉强保住了另一只眼睛微弱的视力。

sentences.en: They had no choice but to amputate his left leg.
sentences.zh: 他们别无选择，只能截去他的左腿。

sentences.en: Almost every internal function of Mark's body had been affected.
sentences.zh: 马克的几乎所有体内机能都受到了影响。

sentences.en: His heart, liver and kidneys had all been permanently compromised, while his weakened gastrointestinal system caused him to bleed from his bowel.
sentences.zh: 他的心脏、肝脏和肾脏都受到了永久性损害，而虚弱的胃肠系统导致他的肠道出血。

sentences.en: The damage to Mark's throat was so severe that a tube was inserted down his throat to keep his airways open.
sentences.zh: 马克喉咙受损严重，一根管子被插入他的喉咙以保持气道畅通。

sentences.en: Multiple lung infections prompted the use of a tracheostomy tube to remove the fluid from his lungs and prevent him choking to death.
sentences.zh: 多次肺部感染促使医生使用气管造口管来清除肺部的液体，防止他窒息身亡。

sentences.en: On a number of occasions, he went into septic shock, causing his blood pressure to drop to potentially fatal levels.
sentences.zh: 他曾多次陷入感染性休克，导致血压降至可能致命的水平。

sentences.en: Doctors battled constantly to keep Mark alive.
sentences.zh: 医生们一直在全力以赴让马克活下去。

sentences.en: Then, in January 2016, four months after he slipped into a coma, Mark Van Dongen woke up.
sentences.zh: 接着，在2016年1月，在他陷入昏迷四个月后，马克·范·东根醒了过来。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目赞助商的内容来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《罪案档案》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: As Mark regained consciousness, the full extent of his injuries became clear.
sentences.zh: 随着马克恢复意识，他伤势的严重程度也逐渐显现出来。

sentences.en: The acid had so severely damaged his motor nerves that he was completely paralysed, unable to move from the neck down.
sentences.zh: 硫酸严重损伤了他的运动神经，导致他彻底瘫痪，脖子以下无法动弹。

sentences.en: It had also eaten away at his vocal cords, rendering him unable to speak a word.
sentences.zh: 它还腐蚀了他的声带，使他连一个字也说不出来。

sentences.en: Yet, Mark's ability to feel remained.
sentences.zh: 然而，马克的触觉依然存在。

sentences.en: In some parts of his body, the acid had decimated the muscle tissue.
sentences.zh: 在他身体的一些部位，硫酸已经彻底摧毁了肌肉组织。

sentences.en: Because the acid was impossible for doctors to remove or neutralise completely, small traces of it continued to slowly erode Mark's bones.
sentences.zh: 由于医生无法完全清除或中和硫酸，微量的硫酸继续慢慢侵蚀着马克的骨骼。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the severe scarring all over Mark's skin caused unbearable itching.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，马克全身严重的疤痕引起了难以忍受的瘙痒。

sentences.en: Doctors administered a constant flow of morphine, but it wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 医生们持续为他注射吗啡，但这还不够。

sentences.en: Every second brought Mark excruciating pain.
sentences.zh: 每一秒钟都带给马克撕心裂肺的剧痛。

sentences.en: Mark remained confined to his hospital bed in the intensive care unit where a team of 29 specialists managed his constant care.
sentences.zh: 马克只能被困在重症监护室的病床上，由29名专家组成的医疗团队对他进行全天候护理。

sentences.en: He was fed intravenously and relied on a ventilator, dialysis machine and catheter.
sentences.zh: 他靠静脉输液维持营养，并依赖呼吸机、透析机和导尿管。

sentences.en: Frequent surgical procedures were necessary to ensure his survival.
sentences.zh: 为了确保他能活下来，频繁的外科手术是必不可少的。

sentences.en: Mark's father, Case, lived and worked in Belgium.
sentences.zh: 马克的父亲凯斯在比利时生活和工作。

sentences.en: While Mark was comatose, Case travelled to England every Friday afternoon and stayed with Mark all weekend, returning to Belgium in time for work on Monday.
sentences.zh: 在马克昏迷期间，凯斯每周五下午都会前往英国，在马克身边陪伴整个周末，然后在周一及时赶回比利时上班。

sentences.en: After Mark woke up, Case never left the hospital.
sentences.zh: 马克醒来后，凯斯再也没有离开过医院。

sentences.en: He remained by his son's bedside for 23 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 他一天23小时都守在儿子的病床边。

sentences.en: Case talked to Mark, hoping his voice would provide him with something to cling to.
sentences.zh: 凯斯跟马克说话，希望自己的声音能给他一些精神寄托。

sentences.en: At times, Case noticed a flicker of responsiveness in Mark's face.
sentences.zh: 有时，凯斯会注意到马克的脸上有了一丝回应的迹象。

sentences.en: He tried everything he could to help provide his son with some relief.
sentences.zh: 他竭尽所能地帮助儿子减轻痛苦。

sentences.en: He scratched Mark's itching skin and rearranged his limbs to ease the nerve pain.
sentences.zh: 他帮马克抓挠发痒的皮肤，并调整他四肢的位置以缓解神经痛。

sentences.en: Over time, Case helped Mark to re-learn how to communicate.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，凯斯帮助马克重新学习如何沟通。

sentences.en: Case developed a painstaking system whereby he pointed to each letter of the alphabet written on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 凯斯发明了一种煞费苦心的系统，他指着写在一张纸上的字母表的每一个字母。

sentences.en: When he reached the letter Mark needed, Mark would stick out his tongue, allowing him to spell out words.
sentences.zh: 当指到马克需要的字母时，马克就会伸出舌头，从而让他拼出单词。

sentences.en: When asked who was responsible for his injuries, Mark spelled Berliner.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是谁造成他的伤势时，马克拼出了“柏莉娜”。

sentences.en: Eventually, doctors were able to fit a speaking valve to the end of the tube in Mark's throat.
sentences.zh: 最终，医生们得以在马克喉咙里气管插管的末端安装一个发声阀。

sentences.en: In July 2016, after five months of speech therapy, Mark regained some of his voice.
sentences.zh: 2016年7月，经过五个月的语言治疗，马克恢复了一部分声音。

sentences.en: Detectives took this opportunity to interview him in hospital.
sentences.zh: 侦探们抓住这个机会在医院采访了他。

sentences.en: Mark recalled the night of the attack in vivid detail.
sentences.zh: 马克对袭击发生当晚的细节记忆犹新。

sentences.en: At around 3am, he recalled waking up in the dark to the sound of laughter in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他回忆说，大约凌晨3点，他在黑暗中醒来，听到卧室里有笑声。

sentences.en: He heard Berliner's voice say, If I can't have you, no one can.
sentences.zh: 他听到柏莉娜的声音说：“如果我得不到你，谁也别想得到。”

sentences.en: Something then struck Mark in the face.
sentences.zh: 接着有什么东西击中了马克的脸。

sentences.en: It burned like hell and Mark let out a terrified scream.
sentences.zh: 它灼痛难忍，马克发出了一声惊恐的尖叫。

sentences.en: As he scrambled out of bed, the pain moved from his face down to his arms and cheSt.
sentences.zh: 当他连滚带爬地下床时，疼痛从他的脸蔓延到手臂和胸部。

sentences.en: He ran from the bedroom and out into the street, screaming.
sentences.zh: 他尖叫着逃出卧室，跑到了街上。

sentences.en: Along with the ongoing physical pain, Mark was plagued by recurring night terrors and flashbacks of the attack.
sentences.zh: 除了持续的身体痛苦，马克还饱受反复发作的夜惊和袭击场景闪回的折磨。

sentences.en: He was diagnosed with depression and post-traumatic stress disorder and prescribed antidepressants.
sentences.zh: 他被诊断患有抑郁症和创伤后应激障碍，并被开具了抗抑郁药物。

sentences.en: Mark's biggest desire was to regain some mobility.
sentences.zh: 马克最大的愿望是恢复一定的活动能力。

sentences.en: He committed everything he had to intensive daily physiotherapy sessions.
sentences.zh: 他全身心投入到每天高强度的物理治疗中。

sentences.en: After months and months, Mark had a major breakthrough when he managed to lightly tickle his father's hand when placed near his own.
sentences.zh: 经过数月的坚持，马克迎来了重大突破：当把父亲的手放在自己手边时，他成功地轻轻触碰了父亲的手。

sentences.en: Mark understood that he'd require extensive round-the-clock care for the rest of his life and would always be in constant, agonising pain.
sentences.zh: 马克明白，在余下的生命中，他需要全天候的广泛护理，并且将永远处于持续、剧烈的疼痛之中。

sentences.en: Regardless, he clung to a glimmer of hope that he could have something closer to a normal life and eventually he raised the possibility of being discharged into a care home.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他依然紧抓着一丝希望，希望能过上更接近正常的生活，并最终提出了转入疗养院的想法。

sentences.en: Case suggested they both go back to Belgium, but Mark was keen to stay in England with Violet.
sentences.zh: 凯斯建议他们俩一起回比利时，但马克执意要留在英国陪维奥莱特。

sentences.en: She remained committed to their relationship and visited him in hospital every day.
sentences.zh: 她依然坚定地维持着他们的恋爱关系，每天都去医院看望他。

sentences.en: On November 22, 2016, after 11 months in the ICU, Mark's wishes were granted when he was transferred to a care home.
sentences.zh: 2016年11月22日，在重症监护室待了11个月之后，马克终于如愿以偿，被转入了疗养院。

sentences.en: Mark insisted that his father return to Belgium and resume his normal life.
sentences.zh: 马克坚持让父亲回比利时恢复正常生活。

sentences.en: Later that same day, Case received a distraught phone call from Mark.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天晚些时候，凯斯接到了马克打来的崩溃的电话。

sentences.en: Case knew immediately that he had to get his son out of the care home.
sentences.zh: 凯斯立刻意识到，他必须把儿子接出疗养院。

sentences.en: He jumped into his car and drove the eight hours from Belgium back to England, arriving at the care home in the early hours of the morning.
sentences.zh: 他跳上汽车，从比利时驱车八个小时赶回英国，在清晨时分抵达了疗养院。

sentences.en: While waiting for a more reasonable time to approach, he decided to take a quick nap in the front seat.
sentences.zh: 在等待一个更合适的时间去拜访之前，他决定在副驾驶座上小睡一会儿。

sentences.en: But Case soon heard screaming and he knew right away that those screams were coming from his son.
sentences.zh: 但凯斯很快听到了尖叫声，他立刻听出那是他儿子的声音。

sentences.en: Case ran up to the home and banged frantically on the door.
sentences.zh: 凯斯跑向疗养院，疯狂地敲打着大门。

sentences.en: Eventually, a staff member opened it.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，一名工作人员把门打开了。

sentences.en: When Case entered Mark's room, he was shocked by what he found.
sentences.zh: 当凯斯走进马克的房间时，眼前的景象让他震惊不已。

sentences.en: Mark was lying on the bed, covered in his own faeces.
sentences.zh: 马克躺在床上，身上沾满了自己的粪便。

sentences.en: The staff had refused to go anywhere near him, too terrified of his appearance.
sentences.zh: 工作人员对他的外表感到十分恐惧，根本不肯靠近他半步。

sentences.en: Case hired a private ambulance and Mark was transferred to a hospital in Belgium that same day, where he was placed in a palliative care unit.
sentences.zh: 凯斯雇了一辆私人救护车，当天就把马克转运到了比利时的一家医院，并被送入姑息治疗病房。

sentences.en: While a team of eight specialists assessed Mark's condition, Case remained by his side until the nurses became accustomed to his appearance.
sentences.zh: 当一个由八名专家组成的医疗团队评估马克的病情时，凯斯一直陪伴在他身旁，直到护士们习惯了他的外表。

sentences.en: By the end of November, Mark was informed of his prognosis.
sentences.zh: 到11月底，马克被告知了他的病情预后。

sentences.en: For Mark, this was the straw that broke the camel's back.
sentences.zh: 对马克来说，这成了压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: He had nothing left and wished to end his life.
sentences.zh: 他已经一无所有，并希望结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: On December 1, Mark submitted an application for voluntary euthanasia.
sentences.zh: 12月1日，马克提交了自愿安乐死申请。

sentences.en: Case could do nothing but support his son's wishes.
sentences.zh: 凯斯除了支持儿子的愿望，别无他法。

sentences.en: Euthanasia was lawful under Belgian law, provided strict control requirements were followed.
sentences.zh: 如果在遵守严格的控制要求的前提下，安乐死在比利时法律中是合法的。

sentences.en: Specially qualified doctors and psychologists assessed Mark's application.
sentences.zh: 具备特殊资质的医生和心理学家对马克的申请进行了评估。

sentences.en: They considered Mark to be mentally competent and found that his application had been made freely and voluntarily.
sentences.zh: 他们认为马克精神状态健全，并发现他的申请是在自由且自愿的情况下提出的。

sentences.en: They concluded that Mark was, and would remain, in a medically futile state of unbearable physical and psychological suffering.
sentences.zh: 他们断定，马克正处于且将持续处于一种医学上无意义的、无法忍受的身体与心理折磨状态中。

sentences.en: His application was approved.
sentences.zh: 他的申请获批了。

sentences.en: The law required Mark to wait for a period of 30 days before the euthanasia could be performed.
sentences.zh: 法律规定马克必须等待30天才能实施安乐死。

sentences.en: Case tried to convince Mark to come home with him during that time, But Mark refused, saying it would be, just another ceiling to look at.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，凯斯试图劝说马克跟他一起回家，但马克拒绝了，说那不过是“换个天花板盯着看罢了”。

sentences.en: One week before the procedure was due to be carried out, Mark developed another lung infection.
sentences.zh: 在预定实施安乐死程序的前一周，马克又患上了肺部感染。

sentences.en: Another tracheostomy tube was needed to remove the fluid from his lungs.
sentences.zh: 需要再次进行气管造口术来清除肺部的液体。

sentences.en: Doctors told Mark that without it, there was a high chance he would choke and die.
sentences.zh: 医生告诉马克，如果不这样做，他有很大几率会窒息身亡。

sentences.en: However, doctors also explained that if they did go ahead with the procedure,
sentences.zh: 然而，医生也解释说，如果他们继续推进这个程序，

sentences.en: there was a 96% chance it would further damage his vocal cords, and he could lose his voice completely.
sentences.zh: 有96%的几率会进一步损伤他的声带，他可能会完全失去声音。

sentences.en: Mark's only wish was to be able to talk to his dad until the very last second.
sentences.zh: 马克唯一的愿望就是能和父亲说话，直到最后一秒。

sentences.en: He declined the treatment.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了治疗。

sentences.en: By January 2, 2017, 15 and a half months had passed since the acid attack.
sentences.zh: 截至2017年1月2日，自泼酸袭击发生以来，已经过去了15个半月。

sentences.en: At 7.15pm that day, Mark shared a final drink with his father and said goodbye.
sentences.zh: 当天晚上7点15分，马克和父亲喝了最后一杯酒，并道了别。

sentences.en: Doctors administered the lethal injection into Mark's heart.
sentences.zh: 医生将致死注射液注入了马克的体内。

sentences.en: After Mark's death, Case told Channel 4 News, That boy went through hell and back.
sentences.zh: 马克死后，凯斯对第四频道新闻说，那孩子经历了人间炼狱。

sentences.en: So much pain.
sentences.zh: 太多的痛苦。

sentences.en: So much itching.
sentences.zh: 太多的瘙痒。

sentences.en: Enough to drive anyone insane.
sentences.zh: 足以把任何人逼疯。

sentences.en: Completely paralysed.
sentences.zh: 彻底瘫痪。

sentences.en: Getting a bullet would be better in comparison.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，挨一颗子弹都更好。

sentences.en: This has been nothing short of torture.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是折磨。

sentences.en: It defies belief.
sentences.zh: 这简直匪夷所思。

sentences.en: When news of Mark's death reached England,
sentences.zh: 当马克死讯传到英国时，

sentences.en: Berlina Wallace was immediately charged with another crime.
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜·华莱士立即被指控另一项罪名。

sentences.en: Murder.
sentences.zh: 谋杀。

sentences.en: Her trial commenced nine months later in November 2017.
sentences.zh: 她的审判在九个月后的2017年11月开始。

sentences.en: Berlina's defence team contested the murder charge, claiming there was no case to answer because Mark Van Dongen had chosen to end his own life.
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜的辩护团队对谋杀指控提出了异议，声称由于马克·范·东根选择结束自己的生命，因此根本不构成犯罪。

sentences.en: The judge decided that the euthanasia was a voluntary act that broke the link between the acid attack committed by Berlina and Mark's death.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定，安乐死是一种自愿行为，打破了伯莉娜实施的泼酸袭击与马克死亡之间的因果链。

sentences.en: For a murder charge to apply, an unbroken link was legally required.
sentences.zh: 要适用谋杀罪，法律上要求因果链条没有中断。

sentences.en: The judge therefore ordered that the charge of murder be withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 因此，法官下令撤销谋杀指控。

sentences.en: The prosecution immediately appealed, and nine days later, the appeal court handed down its ruling.
sentences.zh: 检方立即提起上诉，九天后，上诉法院下达了裁决。

sentences.en: Even though Mark's decision to die was voluntary for the purpose of the Belgian law on euthanasia,
sentences.zh: 尽管就比利时安乐死法律而言，马克选择死亡是自愿的，

sentences.en: it did not automatically mean his death was voluntary in the context of how and why he came to that decision.
sentences.zh: 但这并不自动意味着，在他的决定是如何以及为何做出这一背景下，他的死是自愿的。

sentences.en: The appeal court ruled that the link had not been severed from a legal standpoint.
sentences.zh: 上诉法院裁定，从法律角度来看，因果链条并未断裂。

sentences.en: Whether it had been factually severed was a question to be put to a jury.
sentences.zh: 它是否在事实上断裂，是一个需要交由陪审团裁决的问题。

sentences.en: In May 2018, Berlina Wallace stood trial on both charges, throwing the acid with intent as well as murder.
sentences.zh: 2018年5月，伯莉娜·华莱士因蓄意泼酸和谋杀两项罪名受审。

sentences.en: She testified in her own defence, sticking to the story that Mark himself had filled the glass with acid and tried to trick her into drinking it before launching an assault.
sentences.zh: 她为自己进行了辩护，坚称是马克自己把杯子里装满酸液，并试图诱骗她喝下去，然后才发动了袭击。

sentences.en: Berlina told the jury that she threw what she thought was water over Mark just to make him stop.
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜告诉陪审团，她把自以为是水的东西泼到马克身上，只是为了让他停下来。

sentences.en: Through tears, she insisted that she hadn't meant to hurt him.
sentences.zh: 她泪流满面地坚称，她不是故意要伤害他的。

sentences.en: Berlina claimed she'd never even read the articles about other acid attacks that were found in her online search history.
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜声称，在她网络搜索历史中发现的关于其他泼酸袭击的文章，她甚至根本没有读过。

sentences.en: She said she only looked at the pictures of the victims out of curiosity, labelling the timing as just a coincidence, just bad luck.
sentences.zh: 她说她看受害者的照片只是出于好奇，并称时间纯属巧合，只是运气不好。

sentences.en: The jury heard a recording of Mark's 2016 hospital interview with detectives in which Mark
sentences.zh: 陪审团听取了马克2016年在医院接受侦探采访的录音，马克在录音中

sentences.en: detailed Berlina Wallace's controlling and violent behaviour during their five-year relationship.
sentences.zh: 详细讲述了在他们五年的恋爱关系中，伯莉娜·华莱士具有控制欲和暴力的行为。

sentences.en: He described waking up on the night of the attack to Berlina laughing and repeated what she'd said just before throwing the acid on his face.
sentences.zh: 他描述了在袭击当晚醒来时听到伯莉娜在笑，并重复了她把酸液泼在他脸上之前说的话。

sentences.en: If I can't have you, no one can.
sentences.zh: 如果我得不到你，谁也别想得到。

sentences.en: The judge instructed the jury to consider a series of questions to reach their verdicts.
sentences.zh: 法官指示陪审团考虑一系列问题以做出裁决。

sentences.en: On the first count, the jury had to decide whether Berlina's act of throwing acid over Mark was deliberate.
sentences.zh: 在第一项指控上，陪审团必须决定伯莉娜向马克泼酸的行为是否是蓄意的。

sentences.en: If so, was it done with the intention of causing Mark serious bodily harm?
sentences.zh: 如果是，这样做是否是为了给马克造成严重的身体伤害？

sentences.en: The jury's decision here was unanimous.
sentences.zh: 陪审团在此事上的决定是全票通过。

sentences.en: Berlina Wallace was guilty.
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜·华莱士有罪。

sentences.en: However, for Berlina to be guilty of the second count, murder, the jury had two more questions to consider.
sentences.zh: 然而，要判定伯莉娜犯有第二项罪名——谋杀罪，陪审团还有两个问题需要考虑。

sentences.en: The first was whether the acid attack caused Mark's death.
sentences.zh: 第一个问题是泼酸袭击是否导致了马克的死亡。

sentences.en: While the attack didn't need to be the only cause, the jury had to be satisfied that it was a significant cause.
sentences.zh: 虽然袭击不一定是唯一的死因，但陪审团必须确信它是重要的死因。

sentences.en: If their answer was no, or if they were unsure, they were required to acquit Berlina.
sentences.zh: 如果他们的回答是否定的，或者他们不确定，他们必须宣告伯莉娜无罪。

sentences.en: But, if they had no doubt that Berlina's attack was a significant cause of Mark's death, there was one final question to consider.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果他们毫不怀疑伯莉娜的袭击是马克死亡的一个重要原因，还有一个最后的问题需要考虑。

sentences.en: Could Berlina have predicted that Mark might choose to end his own life as a result of his injuries?
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜是否能预料到马克会因为受伤而选择结束自己的生命？

sentences.en: If the answer was yes, then Berlina would be guilty.
sentences.zh: 如果答案是肯定的，那么伯莉娜就有罪。

sentences.en: After 15 and a half hours of deliberation, the jury reached their verdict.
sentences.zh: 经过15个半小时的审议，陪审团做出了裁决。

sentences.en: They found Berlina Wallace not guilty of murder.
sentences.zh: 他们裁定伯莉娜·华莱士谋杀罪不成立。

sentences.en: Addressing Berlina directly, the judge called her a manipulative and controlling woman who lied without compunction or conscience in an attempt to avoid culpability.
sentences.zh: 法官直接对伯莉娜讲话，称她是一个操纵欲强、控制欲强的女人，为了逃避罪责而毫无愧疚或良知地撒谎。

sentences.en: She stated,
sentences.zh: 她表示，

sentences.en: You ignored Mark's cries of pain and chose not to telephone the emergency services when you would have known that Mark urgently required medical help.
sentences.zh: 你无视马克的痛苦呼喊，在明知马克急需医疗救助的情况下，选择不拨打紧急服务电话。

sentences.en: You caused Mark catastrophic and life-changing injuries and 15 months of intense physical and psychological suffering.
sentences.zh: 你给马克造成了灾难性的、改变一生的伤害，以及长达15个月剧烈的身体和心理痛苦。

sentences.en: It was premeditated and sadistic.
sentences.zh: 这是有预谋的，而且极其虐待狂。

sentences.en: It was an act of pure evil.
sentences.zh: 这是一种纯粹的邪恶行径。

sentences.en: For the acid attack on Mark Van Dongen, Berlina Wallace was sentenced to life imprisonment, with a minimum term of 12 years starting from the date of her arreSt.
sentences.zh: 因对马克·范·东根实施泼酸袭击，伯莉娜·华莱士被判处终身监禁，自被捕之日起服刑期不得少于12年。

sentences.en: Berlina will be eligible for parole in 2027, although the judge stressed that Berlina would only ever be released if she no longer posed a danger to the public.
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜将于2027年获得假释资格，尽管法官强调，只有在伯莉娜不再对公众构成威胁的情况下，她才会被释放。

sentences.en: The attack on Mark in 2015 was just one of hundreds of acid attacks across the United Kingdom that year.
sentences.zh: 2015年对马克的袭击只是当年英国数起泼酸袭击事件之一。

sentences.en: In response to the alarming rise of acid being used as a weapon, the government introduced new restrictions to make it more difficult to obtain.
sentences.zh: 为了应对将酸作为武器使用的惊人上升趋势，政府出台了新的限制措施，使其更难获取。

sentences.en: From July 2018, a special licence was required to purchase sulphuric acid in any concentration above 15%.
sentences.zh: 从2018年7月起，购买任何浓度超过15%的硫酸都需要特别许可证。

sentences.en: This regulation would have prevented Berlina Wallace from attacking Mark Van Dongen with such a devastating substance.
sentences.zh: 这项规定本可以阻止伯莉娜·华莱士用如此毁灭性的物质袭击马克·范·东根。

sentences.en: The UK's then Minister for Crime, Safeguarding and Vulnerability told the press,
sentences.zh: 英国当时的犯罪、保障与脆弱性大臣对媒体表示，

sentences.en: This tragic case illustrates the devastating consequences of acid attacks, and we are determined to end these appalling acts of violence.
sentences.zh: 这起悲惨的案件说明了泼酸袭击的毁灭性后果，我们决心结束这些令人发指的暴力行为。

sentences.en: Berlina's life sentence brought little relief to Mark's father, who had described his son as a gentle man and everyone's friend.
sentences.zh: 伯莉娜的无期徒刑并没有给马克的父亲带来多大宽慰，他曾形容自己的儿子是一个温和的人，也是所有人的朋友。

sentences.en: Case ultimately felt that Mark was too good for this world.
sentences.zh: 凯斯最终觉得马克太美好了，不属于这个世界。

sentences.en: Addressing reporters after the trial, Case was shaking as he said,
sentences.zh: 庭审结束后，凯斯在对记者讲话时浑身颤抖，他说：

sentences.en: Mark was so brave when confronted with the hellish pain and disabilities inflicted upon him.
sentences.zh: 面对施加在自己身上的地狱般痛苦和残疾，马克表现得非常勇敢。

sentences.en: But eventually, it all became too much for him to bear.
sentences.zh: 但最终，这一切对他来说实在太难以承受了。

sentences.en: The court process has been a difficult and emotional experience.
sentences.zh: 庭审过程是一次艰难而情感交织的经历。

sentences.en: I am very disappointed in the outcome of this trial.
sentences.zh: 我对这次庭审的结果感到非常失望。

sentences.en: There are only losers in this case.
sentences.zh: 这个案子里只有输家。

sentences.en: I hope that Mark can now rest in peace.
sentences.zh: 我希望马克现在能够安息。
